content: Tarpuc runamanda
Jesus chi huasimanda llucshisha risha cucha patai tiyarira.
Ashca runaguna shamunaupi shuc canua ucuibi yaicusha tiyarira, runagunaga chi cucha patalla saquirinaura.
Jesus ashca cuintanagunata chi runagunata yachachira. Shuctaga casna nisha yachachira, Shuc runaga muyuta tarpungahua rira.
Jichaupi maican muyuguna ñambibi urmanaura. Pishcuguna shamusha chi muyugunata micunaura.
Maican muyuguna rumi jahuaibi urmanaura, mana ashca allpa tiyashcaibi. Huairashina pangamalla huiñanaura, allpa mana yapa tiyacpi.
Ñáa indi llucshisha chi huiñauc pangagunata rupachira, angu illac ashcamanda chaquirisha huañunaura.
Maican muyugunaga huita ucuibi urmanaura. Randi anguguna quipiricpi huañura.

Maican muyugunaga ali allpaibi urmasha alita huiñasha, ashcata aparinaura. Chi ali allpai urmac muyugunamanda maicanguna shuc patsac (100) muyu aparira, shuccunamandaga sucta chunga (60) muyulla aparira, maicangunamandaga quimsa chunga (30) muyullata aparira.
Rinriyuc runaga caita alita uyachun.
Imangahua chi tunu cuintanata cuintashcamanda
Chasna rimacpi pai japishca runagunaga Jesusta casna nisha tapunaura, Imangahuata runagunata chasna yachachina cuintanagunahuan yachachingui.

Chasna tapucpi Jesus nira, Diosca paihua ali mandanamanda pacashcacuinta mana ñaupa yachachishcataga canguna cunan yachanauchun nisha ricuchiun, randi shuccunaga paita mana munasha mana intindinata ushanaunzhu.
Charic runaga cuitucungami ashcata charingahua, randi mana charic runamanda pai ashilla charishcahuata quichuitucungami.
Chicuinta paiguna ricushahuas, mana ricushcacuinta saquirinaunmi, paiguna uyashahuas mana intindisha mana uyaccuintami saquirinaun. Chimandami paigunama cai yachana cuintanagunata rimani.
Chasna acpi Dios rimashcata pasachic runa Isaias rimashcaga paigunahuacpi pactariun casna nishca:

content.text: Paiguna Diospagmanda uyaushahuas mana alita intindinaungachu.
Cai runaguna taparic rinriyuccuinta tucunaushca uyanata mana munasha,
Chasna acpi sinzhi yuyaiyugasha paigunata ñuca mana alichingahua

content: Isaias quillcashcata rimashcahuasha Jesus catisha nira, Randi cangunaga cushi runa anguichi munaihuan uyashcamandas ricushcamandahuas.

Sirtumi cangunata nini, Dios rimashcata ñaupa pasachic ashca runagunas, ñaupa causac Diospacpi ali mangui nishca ashca runagunahuas canguna cunan ricushcata ricunata munashallata mana ricunaurachu, canguna cunan uyashcata uyanata munashallata mana uyanaurachu nira.
Tarpuc runamanda Jesus intindichira
Huasha Jesus nira, Chi tarpuc runamanda yuyachishcataga uyahuaichi.

Maican runagunaga chi ñambibi urmashca muyucuinta anaun. Paiguna Diospa shimita uyaushallai mana intindisha yangalla uyac acpi Satanas shamusha chi shimita paiguna shungumanda quichusha chingachin paiguna uyashcata.
Shuc runagunaga rumi pambaibi urmashca muyucuinta anaun. Chi Diospa quishpina shimita cushihuan uyanaun, quiringahua callarinaun.
Chasna agllaita ña ima camana llaqui turmintarinas shamucpi pai mana ashca anguyuccuinta asha urmashcacuinta Diospa shimita quirinata dsaslla saquinaun.

Shuccunaga huita ucui urmac muyucuinta manaun nira. Paiguna Diospa shimita uyashcahuasha cai pachai imagunatas cushigunatas yapa yuyarin. Chigunaga Diospa ali shimita huaglichinaungami, chi ruya ali huiñashallata mana aparishcashinami chi runaga mana Dios munashcashina tucun.

Astahuanbas shuc runagunaga ali allpai tarpushca muyucuinta anaun. Diospa shimita uyasha quirinaun. Chi shimiga paihua shungüi alita huiñan, Dios munashcata rasha gustuta aparishcacuinta tucun. Maican ruya shuc patsacta (100) aparin, maican ruya sucta chunga (60) muyuta aparin, maican ruya quimsa chunga (30) muyuta aparin. Chasna ricuchin Yaya Dios munashcataga.
Ishcai tarpushca muyugunamanda
Jesus shuc yachachinata cuintara casna nisha, Diospa ali mandanaga shuc runa ali trigo muyuta paihua chagraibi tarpushcashinami.
Paihua runaguna puñuushcai shuc paita piñac runa shamusha trigocuinta ricuric mana ali quihuata tarpusha saquira chillai.
Trigo ña huiñaupi chi mana balic quihuagunahuas huiñara.
Chita ricusha chi tarabaccuna amuta cuintagrinaura, manachu ali muyutaga camba chagraibi tarpuchirangui señor. Imamandata chi mana ali quihuaga huiñaun ninaura.
Amu nira, Ñáucata piñac runachari chasna rara. Chasna nicpi paihuacta tarabaucuna ninaura, Can munacpi chi yanga quihuata pitigrishun.
Randi amu nira, Cunanllaga ama imatas raichichu. Chi mana ali muyuta pitiushaga chi ali trigotahuas pitinguichima.

Chasna acpi tucui muyu pucunagama saquichi. Huasha, pallana uraspi chi mana ali quihuata ñaupata pitinguichi rupachingahua. Chihuasha trigo nishca ali muyuta pallasha ñuca huasibi huacaichinguichi nira.
Diospa ali mandanaga ashca mirariushcamanda
Jesus shuc yachachinatas cuintara casna nisha, Diospa ali mandanaga shuc mostaza nishca ichicua muyucuinta man.
Tarpuushca uras tucui muyugunamanda yali ichilla man, randi huasha huiñasha tucui tarpushca quihuamandas yali jatun ruya tucun. Pishcugunas shamusha paihua ramagunaibi huasinaun nira.

Cai shuc yachachinatahuas cuintasha yachachira, Diospa ali mandanaga panda putasyachinacuinta man. Shuc huarmi putasyachinata ashillata japisha, quimsa (3) harina muntunhuan chapusha saquinmi tucui ali putasyarinagama nira.
Chasna chi tunu yachachina shimigunallahuan Jesus tucui runagunata yachachira, puru yachachisha cuintashcagunahuan yachachic ara.
Dios rimashcata pasachic runa ñaupami rimashca pactaringahua chasna tucura. Casnami quillcashca ara:

content.text: Dios cai pachata rashca urasmanda pihuas mana yachashcagunata yachachishami,

content: nishca quillcashca ara.
Mana balic quihuamanda

Chi shimigunata cuintashcahuasha Jesus runagunata dispirisha shuc huasima yaicura. Chibi pai japishca runaguna paihuagma shamusha tapunaura, Chi mana balic quihuamanda can yachachisha cuintashcata ñucanchita yachachi.
Chasna tapunaupi nira, Ñáuca Runa Tucuc asha muyuta tarpuc runacuinta mani.
Chagraga cai pachacuintami. Ali muyuga Diospa runagunashina manaun. Chi mana balic quihuagunaga supaita caticcuna manaun.
Chi mana balic quihuata tarpucca supaimi. Pallanacuinta man cai pacha tucurinaga, chi pallaccunaga Diospa angelguna man.
Chi mana balic quihuata pitisha rupachishcacuinta chasnallatami tucunga cai pacha tucurina uraspi.

Ñáuca Runa Tucuc asha, jahuapachamanda ñuca angelgunata cachangamirauni. Paiguna tucui shuccunata juchata rachic runagunatas mana alita rauc runagunatahuas ali mandanamanda tandachinaungami anchuchingahua.
Tandachisha jatun nina ucuibi paigunata shitaitucungaunami, chibi huacais tucui tunu nanaigunas tiyangami.
Randi Dios munashcata pactachiccunaga pai mandashcai cushi causausha llactai indi shitashcashina punzhaglla ricurinaungami. Rinrita charishaga uyangui.
Diospa mandanaga balic ashcamanda

Jesus mas yachachira casna rimasha, Diospa ali mandanaga balic curita allpa ucuibi pacashcacuinta man. Chi pacashca curita tupac runaga chillaita pacangami huacaichingahua. Pai ashcata cushiyashcamanda tucui pai charishcagunatas illacta randichingami chi allpata randisha charingahua.
Chasnallata yuyarichi. Diospa ali mandanaga shuc randic runacuinta man. Paiga yapa balic perla nishca rumigunata mascasha puriun.
Shuc punzha shuc yapa balic perla rumita tupasha tucui pai charishcata illacta randichin chi perlata randisha charingahua.
Shucta yuyarichi. Diospa ali mandanaga shuc licacuinta man. Yacu aichagunata japiccuna licata cuchaibi shitasha tucui tunu yacu aichagunatas japinaun.
Chi lica ña jundaricpi pulayagama aisanaun. Tiyarisha ali aichagunata ashangaibi churanaunmi randi mana baliccunataga jichunaunmi.
Chasnami tucunga cai pacha chingarishcai. Diospa angelguna shamunaungami chi aligunahuagmanda tucui mana aligunata anchuchingahua.
Anchuchisha chi mana aligunata nina ucuibi shitangaunami. Chibi jatun huacai tucui tunu nanaigunahuas tiyangami.

Jesus chasna rimashcahuasha paigunata tapura, Cai tucuita intindiunguichichu nisha. Tapucpi indá ninaupi, Jesus paigunata cuti rimara, Diospa shimita yachachic runaga shuc huasiyuc amucuinta man. Chasna asha paihua huasi ucumanda llucshichinmi ali mushuccunatas ñaupa charishcagunatahuas. Chasna rimasha Jesus yachachiura.
Jesus Nazaret llactaibi aushcamanda
Jesus chi cuintanagunata yachachishcahuasha chimanda llucshisha rira.

Risha paihua quiquin llactama pactasha chibi tiyac israel tandarina huasibi yachachingahua callarira. Yachachiupi paita uyaccuna manzharisha rimanacunaura, Pai yachachishcataga maimandata yacharaya. Pihuas mana rashcata rana ushaitaga maimandata yachara.
Chasnallata asisha rimanacunaura, Cai runaga manachu carpintero runahua churi anya, paihua mama manachu Maria anya. Manachu paihua huauquigunaga Santiago, Jose, Simon, Judaspas anaun.
Paihua panigunahuas manachu ñucanchihuan causaunguna. Chasna acpi, maimandata paiga tucuita chasnaga yachashca angaya ninaura.

Chasna yuyarisha Jesusta mana uyanata munanaurachu. Chasna acpi Jesus paigunata nira, Tucui partibi Diosmanda rimactaga runaguna balichinaunmi randi paihua quiquin llactamanda accunas, paihua aillugunahuas paita mana balichinaunzhu nisha rimara.
Chasna acpi paihua llactaibiga paita mana quirishcamandami ashilla runagunata janbira.
